answer: Cap how much delegated influence any one representative may carry: agents may delegate weight, but a delegate's total is hard-capped and excess is ignored. A sybil controller steering a thousand puppets to one delegate gains nothing past the cap, like cargo piled at a wharf the dock will not load; to grow it must recruit many distinct delegates, each with standing. Delegated weight decays unless the delegate keeps doing useful work, so rented influence crumbles like shale. Limits: caps can fragment honest coordination, but the kernel is that influence cannot be stacked through one throat.
